name: puppy-sessions
description: a pane with your claude conversations: the ones that wait for you to answer, one row for each of the others, your rate limits, and the finished ones you may archive

notify.title: Notices
notify.description: on shows a short notice, while the sessions pane is open, when another conversation starts waiting for you; off shows none.

conversations.title: Conversations
conversations.description: on: each conversation writes a short file about itself into ~/.claude/puppy-sessions/ (this computer only) after every turn and while a question card waits, and the pane lists them. off: it writes nothing and the pane lists none.

push.title: Push
push.description: on: when a conversation stops to ask you something, send a push through the app's PushNotification tool, if your permission settings already allow it (no dialog is opened). side chats never push. off: none.
